query:
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO save_leases
                 (save_id, holder_user_id, holder_device_fp, acquired_at, renewed_at,
                  base_version, pushed_since, released_at)
             VALUES (?, ?, ?, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'),
                     strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'), ?, 0, NULL)
